name: Edge of the Divinity — boosts depend on the enchanted creature's color
notes: Memory: project_edge_of_divinity_color_condition_2026-05-17. 'enchanted creature is white' was read as the Enchanted trait, so both boosts applied to every enchanted creature. Savannah Lions (white 2/1) must get +1/+2 = 3/3, Vampire Nighthawk (black 2/3) +2/+1 = 4/4, Grizzly Bears (green) nothing = 2/2. (White Knight is unusable: Edge is black and the Knight has protection from black.)
